# jsQR

Locally bundled QR image decoder from the official project: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cozmo/jsQR/master/dist/jsQR.js

Downloaded October 9, 2026. The upstream Apache 2.0 license is included in `LICENSE-jsQR.txt`. This unmodified browser bundle is used for camera frames and user-selected images in Issue Documents. It does not upload images or depend on an external CDN at runtime.
